name: Heroic Assault (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Magus 9

Benefit: The magus can expend 1 point from his arcane pool as a swift action to augment his actions with arcane energy. This functions as heroism, but only targets the magus and lasts for a number of rounds equal to the magus’s Intelligence modifier.
